subject: 200 Middlesex Avenue Facade Design Review
overview: The Community Development Board reviewed architectural details for a life science project at 200 Middlesex Avenue to satisfy a specific condition of its special permit. The board also coordinated upcoming meeting dates and postponed the approval of minutes.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the consideration of meeting minutes until the January 5th meeting.

items.title: 200 Middlesex Avenue Site Plan Review Condition
items.summary: Reviewed and considered design details for the southwest corner facade of the building at 200 Middlesex Avenue as required by a condition of the July site plan review. Representatives from Oxford Properties Group and SGA presented material choices and screening designs for utility tanks to ensure the project meets industrial and aesthetic standards for the corridor.

items.title: Miscellaneous Updates and Scheduling
items.summary: Discussed administrative updates and scheduled future meetings to accommodate upcoming site plan review applications expected in early 2022.
